test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In what time will a sum of Rs. 6,400 amount to Rs. 7,168 at 6% simple interest per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 6,400

Amount (A) = Rs. 7,168

Rate of Interest (R) = 6% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = P × R × T / 100

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

**Calculation:**

SI = A - P

⇒ SI = 7,168 - 6,400

⇒ SI = 768

Using the simple interest formula:

SI = P × R × T / 100

768 = 6,400 × 6 × T / 100

768 = 384 × T

⇒ T = 768 / 384

⇒ T = 2 years

**The correct answer is option 1.**
